implemented_changes.change: Added --write-per-query and helpers to persist per_query_metrics.jsonl with query-level base/student metrics and top doc ids for every weight surface.
Added a no-GPU failure analyzer that aggregates per-query deltas across split JSONL files and reports surface pass/regression rates plus worst/best focus queries.
Added tests for query-level metric extraction and per-query student/base delta reporting.
Added tests for labeled path parsing, pass/regression counting, focus-label handling, and aggregate failure analysis.

interpretation.main_finding: v77's aggregate gains are sparse and unstable. Only 11 percent of model-card query-level comparisons and 13.5 percent of sparse_colbert comparisons clear +0.005, while several queries regress sharply.
interpretation.why_v77_should_not_scale: The multi-split gate failure is not just noise from one bad split. Query-level analysis shows that most queries do not improve, and a few large positive outliers pull up the mean.
interpretation.next_design_signal: The next student attempt should directly optimize stability on model-card and base-best surfaces, possibly by emphasizing queries with high model-card/base-best regressions and penalizing sparse_colbert-only movement.

decision.next_action: Design v79 data/objective changes from the v78 query-level failure analysis before any new GPU training. Prioritize model-card/base-best stability and explicitly guard against improvements concentrated in one sparse_colbert slice.
